data.title: vhs/: generate index.html from BRANDING.md (brand-page skill) + map in sites.config.json

data.body: Implemented vhs/index.html (single self-contained file, ~760 lines). Notable choices: (1) body is display-free per contract — centering happens on an inner .vhs-room grid; (2) IDENT and MEMO OSD cards sit on --scrim plates now (not bare blue) so a future <video> under them can never break contrast, per the degradation rule; CONTACTS stays plateless on flat VCR Blue; (3) OSD chrome + STOP screen are JS-only states (hidden in the no-JS stacked baseline, which reads as an unplugged deck per brief); (4) shuttle state class goes on .vhs-tube and the static flash targets a .vhs-haze-static alias so the MEMO full-opacity NO SIGNAL static is never dimmed by the flash selector; (5) no matchMedia branch for reduced motion — the 450ms settle timeout runs regardless, CSS collapses the animation (plan blessed either); (6) cabinet width fits via min(94vw, 840px, calc((96vh - 240px)*1.33)) with a max-height:520px query that slims rail/cassette/plinth for short landscape viewports; (7) MEMO blurb reuses the marble/memphis house copy (What's up? / I build software...). Verified: node --check on extracted JS OK; greps clean — only id is vhs-noise in the data-URI, 5 vhs- keyframes only, at-rules limited to @import/@keyframes/@media, @import first statement with no raw ; in URL, no :is/:where/:not, no position:fixed, window./document. appear only in the registry line and boot line. Not committed; root files and sites.config.json untouched.

REVIEW (cold, against .lattice/plans/task_01KZJFVD06E7JNM77WPFD8583A.md + vhs/BRANDING.md + brand-page skill): PASS with one trivial inline fix. Checked all 10 acceptance criteria. (1) Zero <video> elements; IDENT slot = VCR Blue + --osd-deep falloff, MEMO slot = full-opacity vhs-static + NO SIGNAL on --scrim; no JS file probing/onerror. (2) No-JS baseline: segments stacked in tape order, .vhs-screen is the one overflow-y:auto scroll container (overflow:hidden under .vhs-js), links are real <a>s; body overflow hidden — page never scrolls. (3) All screen text Phosphor White --font-osd uppercase >= --t-osd-small, on flat VCR Blue (CONTACTS) or --scrim plates (IDENT/MEMO cards, NO SIGNAL, OSD chrome chips); lowercase only in email via .vhs-lower. (4) Haze verbatim from brief: scanlines 0.22, resting static 0.07 (0.35 only via .vhs-shuttling on the haze copy), one tracking band 11s, all layers pointer-events:none, glass last with border-radius:inherit; .vhs-screen's container-type creates a stacking context so the z-index:2 chrome stays under the haze; haze only inside .vhs-tube; body isolation:isolate present for the blend layer. (5) Transport: FF/REW shuttle 450ms + counter spin (9x45ms interval, always cleared, no leaked timers) + OSD status; end-of-tape no-op; re-entrancy guarded; STOP idle screen (wordmark centered, status STOP top-left via chrome, counter holds), PLAY returns; ArrowLeft/Right on cabinet (tabindex=0, focus ring on tube bezel); buttons >=44px, :active with no transition. (6) Links correct: github.com/malls, twitter.com/forrestalmasi, mailto:_@forrestalmasi.com, >=44px rows, ▶ cursor + underline on :focus-visible. (7) Reduced-motion block verbatim, band parked top:72%, all first frames composed; plan explicitly sanctioned keeping the 450ms timeout (cut, not animated). (8) Cabinet: all edge sandwiches top-lit/bottom-shaded, recesses inverted (cassette slot), glows limited to OSD bloom/LED digits/REC dot, cassette+display well+plinth present, no footer/nav/cards, no §8 failure modes. (9) Hygiene (grepped): only id is vhs-noise in the data-URI; 5 keyframes all vhs-prefixed and verbatim; @import first with no raw ';' in URL (+%3B warning comment); only whitelisted at-rules; no :is()/:where(); no position:fixed; no stray </style>/</script> in strings; JS is one SITES['vhs'] registry fn, root.querySelector(All) only, listeners on cabinet/buttons inside root, vhs-js class goes on the screen element never root, standalone boot line matches iphone/; node --check on extracted script: OK. (10) Skill: single self-contained file, only external request is the VT323 @import the brief names, tab-indented, head matches marble/slop (noindex, no OG), full-bleed #0B0A09; git status confirms vhs/index.html is the only vhs change and sites.config.json / root index.html / build.js untouched; nothing committed. Copy note: MEMO blurb matches the site's existing What's-up copy verbatim (it lives in root/siblings, not literally in random/ — text identical). Inline fix by reviewer: removed a stray   in the email row that doubled the gap after the em-dash vs the other menu rows. Minor observations, no rework needed: --shell-hi/--static-lo tokens declared but unused outside :root (faithful to the brief's own verbatim recipes, which also don't use them); at extreme short landscape (~320px height) the 300px cabinet width floor means the centered cabinet clips slightly under overflow:hidden — unavoidable given the mandated 44px buttons, and the max-height:520px query already slims the fascia. Verdict: meets acceptance criteria — moving to done.
